chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of his companions, from Ibn Muskān, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
the killer of Al-Husayn ibn Ali is a son of fornication.
ai.seo_question: Who is the killer of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) identifies the killer of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) as a 'walad zina' (son of fornication), a title often attributed to 'Amr ibn al-Haram al-Khuza'i, signifying his distinct lineage or spiritual illegitimacy compared to the pure Ahl al-Bayt. This designation underscores the theological concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (knowledge of the unseen) possessed by the Imams, who could discern the intrinsic nature and future actions of individuals through divine revelation. The term serves as a permanent mark of distinction for the killers of the Prophet's household, linking their physical act to a deeper spiritual reality.
